notes: Dark photon kinetic mixing constraint from patchy dark screening of the CMB using Planck x unWISE cross-correlation. 95% CL upper limits on epsilon over mass range 1e-13 to ~1e-11 eV. Paper quotes epsilon < 4e-8 for most of the range, dipping to epsilon < 2.08e-8 (joint) at the most sensitive mass ~5.2e-13 eV. Data points are approximate readings of the joint exclusion curve (Fig. 3 / Fig. S12); exact tabulated values not provided. This is a cosmological bound (CMB photon-to-dark-photon conversion), not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density is assumed. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
